mapper.insert: INSERT INTO warehouse_route (id, enterprise_id, warehouse_id, cell_id, target_cell_id, route_epoch, state, cutoff_at, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{enterpriseId}, #{warehouseId}, #{cellId}, #{targetCellId}, #{epoch}, #{state}, #{cutoff}, 0, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE updated_at=updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT id, cell_id, target_cell_id, route_epoch, state, cutoff_at, version FROM warehouse_route WHERE enterprise_id=#{enterpriseId} AND warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM location_gate WHERE enterprise_id=#{enterpriseId} AND warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} AND state<>'OPEN'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM location_gate WHERE enterprise_id=#{enterpriseId} AND warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} AND state<>'OPEN' AND NOT(state='MAINTENANCE' AND reason_code <=> 'WAREHOUSE_MIGRATION')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inventory_tcc_intent WHERE enterprise_id=#{enterpriseId} AND warehouse_id=#{warehouseId})
